    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Event_BeerRepliesReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Event_BeerRepliesReceived" targetRef="Gateway_BeerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="End_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Invitation" name="Invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_GameList" name="List of desired games"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DateProposal" name="Proposed date"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Availability" name="Availability reply"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BeerRequest" name="Beer amount request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BeerAmount" name="Beer amount needed"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_LANParty" name="LAN party planning">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organizer" name="Organizer (you)" processRef="Process_Organizer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends" processRef="Process_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Invitation" name="Send invitations" sourceRef="Send_Invitations" targetRef="Start_Invitation" messageRef="Msg_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_GameList" name="Send game list" sourceRef="Send_GameList" targetRef="Catch_GameList" messageRef="Msg_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DateProposal" name="Send proposed date" sourceRef="Send_DateProposal" targetRef="Catch_DateProposal" messageRef="Msg_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Availability" name="Send availability" sourceRef="Send_Availability" targetRef="Catch_AvailabilityReplies" messageRef="Msg_Availability"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BeerRequest" name="Ask for beer amount" sourceRef="Send_BeerRequest" targetRef="Catch_BeerRequest" messageRef="Msg_BeerRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BeerAmount" name="Send beer amount" sourceRef="Send_BeerAmount" targetRef="Catch_BeerAmounts" messageRef="Msg_BeerAmount"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Organizer" name="Organizer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Planning" name="Planning of LAN party starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Invitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>F1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_GameList" name="Game list received">
      <bpmn:incoming>F2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GameList" messageRef="Msg_GameList"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Fork_Planning" name="Start date search and game check">
      <bpmn:incoming>F3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="DateMerge" name="Date merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>F4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>F6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_DateProposal" name="Send proposed date to friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>F7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_AvailabilityReplies" name="Availability replies received">
      <bpmn:incoming>F8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Availability" messageRef="Msg_Availability"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateCheck" name="8 or more people agree on date?">
      <bpmn:incoming>F9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all desired games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>F5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesCheck" name="Games missing?">
      <bpmn:incoming>F12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>F13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Games" name="Games check complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>F14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Planning" name="Date agreed and games checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>F10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_BeerRequest" name="Ask friends how much beer they need">
      <bpmn:incoming>F17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BeerAmounts" name="Beer amounts received">
      <bpmn:incoming>F18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BeerAmount" messageRef="Msg_BeerAmount"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindBeer" name="Find out how much beer is required">
      <bpmn:incoming>F19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerCheck" name="Enough beer?">
      <bpmn:incoming>F20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F21</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>F21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Beer" name="Beer available">
      <bpmn:incoming>F22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>F24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LANParty" name="LAN party finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>F25</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start_Planning" targetRef="Send_Invitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Send_Invitations" targetRef="Catch_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Catch_GameList" targetRef="Fork_Planning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Fork_Planning" targetRef="DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Fork_Planning" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="DateMerge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Send_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Send_DateProposal" targetRef="Catch_AvailabilityReplies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="Catch_AvailabilityReplies" targetRef="Gateway_DateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" name="Yes, at least 8 people agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Join_Planning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" name="No, fewer than 8 people agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" name="Some games missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesCheck" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" name="All games available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesCheck" targetRef="Merge_Games"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Merge_Games"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16" sourceRef="Merge_Games" targetRef="Join_Planning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F17" sourceRef="Join_Planning" targetRef="Send_BeerRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F18" sourceRef="Send_BeerRequest" targetRef="Catch_BeerAmounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F19" sourceRef="Catch_BeerAmounts" targetRef="Task_FindBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F20" sourceRef="Task_FindBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F21" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F22" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Merge_Beer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F23" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Merge_Beer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F24" sourceRef="Merge_Beer" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F25" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="End_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Friends" name="Friends process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Invitation" name="Invitation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>G1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Invitation" messageRef="Msg_Invitation"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_GameList" name="Send desired games">
      <bpmn:incoming>G1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DateProposal" name="Date proposal received">
      <bpmn:incoming>G2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DateProposal" messageRef="Msg_DateProposal"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Availability" name="Send availability for date">
      <bpmn:incoming>G3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BeerRequest" name="Beer amount request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>G4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BeerRequest" messageRef="Msg_BeerRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_BeerAmount" name="Send how much beer is needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>G5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Friends" name="Friend's reply completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>G6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G1" sourceRef="Start_Invitation" targetRef="Send_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G2" sourceRef="Send_GameList" targetRef="Catch_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G3" sourceRef="Catch_DateProposal" targetRef="Send_Availability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G4" sourceRef="Send_Availability" targetRef="Catch_BeerRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G5" sourceRef="Catch_BeerRequest" targetRef="Send_BeerAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G6" sourceRef="Send_BeerAmount" targetRef="End_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
